reflected_basic.name: Reflected XSS - Basic HTML
reflected_basic.description: Basic HTML markup probes used to detect reflected input that is rendered as HTML.

reflected_script.name: Reflected XSS - Script Context
reflected_script.description: Script-oriented probes for inputs reflected into executable JavaScript contexts.

event_handler.name: Event Handler XSS
event_handler.description: HTML event-handler probes used to identify contexts where attacker-controlled attributes are interpreted.

attribute_context.name: HTML Attribute Context
attribute_context.description: Quote-breaking probes used to detect reflection inside HTML attributes.

tag_breakout.name: HTML Tag Breakout
tag_breakout.description: Markup probes designed to detect whether user input can break out of an existing HTML element.

encoded.name: Encoded XSS
encoded.description: Encoded representations used to identify inadequate output encoding or decoding before rendering.

javascript_protocol.name: JavaScript URL Context
javascript_protocol.description: URL-context probes for inputs that may be placed into href or similar URL attributes.

svg_context.name: SVG-based XSS
svg_context.description: SVG markup probes for HTML contexts that permit SVG elements.

stored_marker.name: Stored XSS Marker
stored_marker.description: Unique persistent markers used to determine whether attacker-controlled input is stored and later reflected.

dom_marker.name: DOM XSS Marker
dom_marker.description: Markers used to identify attacker-controlled data reaching browser DOM sinks.

template_context.name: Template Context XSS
template_context.description: Template-expression probes for applications that interpolate user-controlled values through client or server templates.

plain_marker.name: Reflection Marker
plain_marker.description: Harmless unique markers used to establish whether input is reflected before interpreting the result as an XSS finding.
